domain: SAI-06 Document & Data Intelligence / RAG Architecture

records.title: ColPali OCR-Free Vision-Language Retrieval
records.problemSolved: Preserve visual and spatial structure in complex PDF pages without flattening through OCR.
records.architectureSummary: Indexes page images as multi-vector visual representations and uses late-interaction retrieval between query tokens and page patches.
records.notes: Owner-supplied Gemini output records this as a 2026 research pattern. Storage and dimensionality claims require current primary-source verification before implementation.

records.title: Corrective RAG (CRAG) Retrieval Evaluator
records.problemSolved: Prevent irrelevant retrieved context from being forwarded blindly to generation.
records.architectureSummary: Adds a retrieval-evaluator gate that classifies retrieved evidence and can trigger query rewriting or fallback retrieval before generation.
records.notes: Research evidence only. Exact evaluator design, thresholds and fallback providers are not approved by this registry.

records.title: Self-RAG Reflective Generation
records.problemSolved: Detect unsupported claims and insufficient evidence during generation.
records.architectureSummary: Uses reflection or critique signals during generation so the model can request additional retrieval and revise unsupported output.
records.notes: Research evidence only; reflection-token details and implementation mechanism require model-specific verification.
